faq.description: Transparent clarity regarding intellectual property ownership, development timelines, cost estimation, and our software engineering standards.

items.question: How is intellectual property (IP) and source code ownership handled?
items.answer: 100% of all source code, Git repositories, and architecture assets are fully transferred to your company upon milestone completion with zero royalty fees and no vendor lock-in.

items.question: What is the typical timeframe for developing an enterprise system or app?
items.answer: Timeline depends on scope. Focused MVPs or targeted operational modules are typically delivered in 4–8 weeks. For complex enterprise ecosystems, we work in disciplined 2-week Agile sprints.

items.question: Does PT Tehnonusa provide post-launch warranties and SLA support?
items.answer: Yes. Every delivery is covered by our comprehensive bug-free warranty and system availability SLA guarantees, alongside continuous security monitoring and backups.

items.question: How do you calculate project investment and pricing?
items.answer: Costs are calculated transparently according to architectural requirements, functional modules, and target deployment schedule. We provide complimentary technical architecture consultations.

items.question: Can the new platform integrate with our existing legacy enterprise systems?
items.answer: Absolutely. Our engineers specialize in database migration, custom API middleware bridges, and legacy modernization, allowing seamless data flow without halting day-to-day operations.
